verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own docs describe Copilot Chat embedded in Teams and a documented ability to create/chat with 'agents' in Teams that can execute tasks via slash commands and conversational triggers, which is direct evidence of a built-in AI assistant a user can delegate to. However, all evidence is first-party docs with no independent/hands-on confirmation that task delegation actually works well in practice, and community evidence in the pack is unrelated to Copilot/agent functionality (it's about UI/performance complaints). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on validation of the AI assistant successfully completing delegated tasks, and clearer detail on autonomy/scope of agent actions.
